title: 花太多了

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: Left X accepts a single stem from right-hand florist N; N pulls successive bunches from below counter into X’s arms. Flower stack rises to X’s eyes then only silver cowlick visible; X lowers the armful below counter, emerges behind it and starts loop. No more than two hands per person.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw X on the left, right fingers closing around the single stem in right-hand florist N’s right hand; X’s left palm waits beneath it, and N’s left hand rests on the counter. 2) 0.45 s: Draw X cradling the stem in the left arm, right hand securing it; N reaches the right hand below the counter, and both watch the flower. 3) 1.00 s: Draw N’s right hand releasing the first bunch onto X’s arms at chest height; X looks pleased, and N’s left hand stays planted. 4) 1.60 s: Draw N’s right hand delivering a second bunch from below the counter, raising the stack to X’s eyes; X peers over it with widening eyes. 5) 2.20 s: Draw N withdrawing the empty right hand after adding a third bunch from below the counter; flowers hide X except for the silver cowlick, with both supporting hands concealed underneath. 6) 2.90 s: Draw X bending knees and lowering the entire armful to chest height, revealing overwhelmed eyes; both hands support it underneath while N watches. 7) 3.50 s: Draw X crouched behind the counter, placing the whole armful into concealed storage; only the silver cowlick peeks above the edge while N reaches below with the right hand. 8) 4.00 s: Draw X rising behind the counter with empty hands and a relieved expression; N lifts a fresh single stem in the right hand, left hand still resting on the counter. 9) 4.55 s: Draw X upright with the left palm cupped and open right fingers just short of the offered stem; N extends it toward those fingers, and both watch the approaching handoff.
Continuity: Use a fixed camera and 4.8-second loop, keep each person limited to two hands and N’s left hand planted, retain all flowers until stored below the counter, and join pose nine’s reaching fingers directly to pose one’s closing grip. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

strip-0.prompt:
Act as a senior 2D inbetween animator. Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: Left X accepts a single stem from right-hand florist N; N pulls successive bunches from below counter into X’s arms. Flower stack rises to X’s eyes then only silver cowlick visible; X lowers the armful below counter, emerges behind it and starts loop. No more than two hands per person.
A = 0.00 s: Draw X on the left, right fingers closing around the single stem in right-hand florist N’s right hand; X’s left palm waits beneath it, and N’s left hand rests on the counter.
B = 0.45 s: Draw X cradling the stem in the left arm, right hand securing it; N reaches the right hand below the counter, and both watch the flower.
C = 1.00 s: Draw N’s right hand releasing the first bunch onto X’s arms at chest height; X looks pleased, and N’s left hand stays planted.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
